headline_marked: 1 million QR codes active: [[Bangladesh launches universal Bangla QR]] for payments
headline: 1 million QR codes active: Bangladesh launches universal Bangla QR for payments
summary: Over 90% of merchant points have transitioned to the universal system, leading to a 15% increase in digital transactions.
details: Bangladesh has taken a significant step toward a cashless society by implementing a universal 'Bangla QR' code system. From July 1, Bangladesh Bank made the use of this universal code mandatory for all merchant points.

Currently, approximately 1 million QR codes are active across the country, with over 90% of these points already replaced by the Bangla QR system. This allows customers to use payment services from any financial institution through a single QR code.

The impact was immediate, with merchants reporting a 15% increase in transactions on the first day of implementation. Merchants have welcomed the move, although some are still waiting to receive their codes.

To support the transition, the central bank has slightly increased the profit rates for merchants. Additionally, the government is coordinating with various ministries and regulatory agencies to ensure the rapid spread of the the system.

Regarding costs, a minimum Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) of 1% (including VAT) will apply to merchant payments. This fee will be deducted from the merchant's earnings and cannot be charged to the customer.

headline_marked: 573 members vote in [[Bangladesh Film Artiste Association election]]
headline: 573 members vote in Bangladesh Film Artiste Association election
summary: Two competing panels are battling for leadership for the 2026-2028 term, with voting running until 6pm on Friday.
details: Voting has begun for the biennial election of the Bangladesh Film Artiste Association (BFAA), with 573 members choosing their leadership for the 2026-2028 term.
Polls opened at 9:30am on Friday and will run until 6pm. The election centre was reported to be quiet in the first hour, with few voters turning up early.
Two panels are contesting the election. One is led by fighter and producer Arman Khan for president and actress Rumana Islam Mukti for general secretary.
The opposing panel is led by Shiba Shanu for president and Joy Chowdhury for general secretary, with several other candidates for various executive positions.
Election commissioners Kibria Lipu, Khorshed Alam Khosru and BH Nishan are overseeing the process.
Actor Ejajul Islam, who voted early, expressed hope that the election ends smoothly and that the association remains united after the results are announced.
caption:
Who will lead the Bangladeshi film industry's artiste association? 573 members are casting their ballots today.

Voting has begun for the biennial election of the Bangladesh Film Artiste Association (BFAA), with 573 members choosing their leadership for the 2026-2028 term.

Polls opened at 9:30am on Friday and will run until 6pm. The election centre was reported to be quiet in the first hour, with few voters turning up early.

Two panels are contesting the election. One is led by fighter and producer Arman Khan for president and actress Rumana Islam Mukti for general secretary.

The opposing panel is led by Shiba Shanu for president and Joy Chowdhury for general secretary, with several other candidates for various executive positions.

Election commissioners Kibria Lipu, Khorshed Alam Khosru and BH Nishan are overseeing the process.

Actor Ejajul Islam, who voted early, expressed hope that the election ends smoothly and that the association remains united after the results are announced.

#Bangladesh #BFAA #Dhallywood #FilmIndustry #Election2024

Source: bdnews24.com, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star, Somoy News
